MonoBehaviour.jobDescription: Finish the direct route from Vance's middle supply point to the community. Build a safe 100-meter crossing and observe how its members and supports distribute the test vehicle's load.

offerDialogue.name: Silas
sentences: Now that you understand load distribution, let's put that knowledge to use.
We need a bridge that connects the community to the main route.
A jeep will test this route before Vance's supplies continue to the community.
There's a rock formation partway across, but it sits much lower than the roads on either side.
<#E09500>You'll have to decide how to use the available support points across the site.
Remember, the way you arrange the bridge and its supports affects how the vehicle's weight is distributed.
<#E09500>Watch how the whole structure responds when the jeep crosses.
If you're ready, take the contract.

reminderDialogue.name: Silas
sentences: Remember what we discussed about load distribution.
Think carefully about where you place the supports, and keep an eye on how the whole bridge responds during the test.

finishedContractDialogue.name: Silas
sentences: The community has a direct connection to the route now. Vance's supplies can continue from the middle point.
They won't have to take the long way around anymore.
That was a wider crossing than your earlier projects.
You also got to see how the bridge's design and support arrangement affect the way it carries weight.
I've got a feeling this won't be the last project we handle together.
